user.title: Action1 API credential
user.description: Create an API credential in the Action1 console. A read-only role is enough: the integration never changes anything in Action1.

data_description.region: The data center your Action1 account lives in, as in the console address (app.eu.action1.com is Europe).

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: This credential can see several organizations. Pick the one to add; add the integration again for another.

reauth_confirm.title: New API credential
reauth_confirm.description: Action1 rejected the API credential for {title}. Enter a working one for the same organization.

error.invalid_auth: Action1 rejected the client ID or secret.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Action1 API in this region.
error.wrong_organization: This credential can't see the organization this entry was set up for.

abort.already_configured: This Action1 organization is already set up.
abort.no_organizations: The credential works but can't see any organization.

data_description.ignored_groups: PCs in any of these Action1 groups get no entities, e.g. PCs in storage. Their existing devices can then be deleted from the device page.
